OrderCollectionResponse.nextLink: Link to the next page of orders.

OrderV1_0.id: Id from internal order database, is numeric value and starting from 10000.
OrderV1_0.orderId: Can be BPM orderID like 'BPMT0153200309110744' or just Order Id from OrderManager '99089093'.
OrderV1_0.parentOrderId: Parent order id if this order is a return of another order.
OrderV1_0.implementationCaseId: Implementation case Id coming from SalesForce channel.
OrderV1_0.bpmOrderId: Bpm order id returned from CoPE services.
OrderV1_0.mitIdVerificationToken: Token used for verification of the identity of the person making the order.
OrderV1_0.batchId: Identifier of the batch the order is being processed in.
OrderV1_0.brand: must be entered in the 'brand' header and is then placed on the order.
OrderV1_0.channel: Identifying what channel the order is made in, e.g. SALES_FORCE, TANGO, SELF_SERVICE ...
OrderV1_0.createdDate: Date time with timezone according to ISO-8601.
OrderV1_0.completedDate: Date time with timezone according to ISO-8601. Timestamp of when the order has been completed or cancelled.
OrderV1_0.createdBy: Identifier of the person making this order.
OrderV1_0.orderParts: The order can have multiple order parts not requiring to be on account (e.g. subscription product change or sales of accessories).
OrderV1_0.hardwareDeliveries: Multiple hardware deliveries allow deliveries to multiple locations.
OrderV1_0.taskUrl: Link to task for order manual handling.
OrderV1_0.orderTotal: Sum of all one time fees, charges, and additional product one time price (like hardware price.
OrderV1_0.hardwareTotal: Sum of hardware amount to be paid.
OrderV1_0.hardwareTotalUpfront: Sum of hardware upfront amount (to be paid immediately).
OrderV1_0.productTotalUpfront: Sum of product upfront amount (to be paid immediately).
OrderV1_0.paymentId: Id of related payment entity in PaymentIntegrationLayer API.
OrderV1_0.contextId: Context id to be used as header for NOOS Orders

ChangeActivationDateOrderPatch.newActivationDate: New activation date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).

OrderSource.captureTimeStamp: Date time with timezone according to ISO-8601. Timestamp of when the order has been completed or cancelled.

OrderFlags.orderConfirmed: Whether the order is confirmed or approved.
OrderFlags.termsAccepted: If customer agrees with terms and conditions. Must be true :)
OrderFlags.needsConfirmation: Customer shall confirm the order as sales agent made it on their behalf.
OrderFlags.membershipCheck: If there is any membership to be checked (voucher number or so)
OrderFlags.dirty: The order is missing mandatory information
OrderFlags.doLogistics: Shall the backend send request for hardware shipment
OrderFlags.posFlow: Order has been created via new POS
OrderFlags.homeOfficeOrder: If order represents Home Office order
OrderFlags.createDraftOrder: If draft order should be created during shopping cart submission
OrderFlags.manualSigning: If order follows manual signing flow
OrderFlags.simOnly: If order is from Tango and has only SIM AdditionalProductItems
OrderFlags.hasUpfrontPayment: If order is from Tango and has at least one upfront payment on any HardwarePaymentItem
OrderFlags.tfFinancingNeeded: If order is from Tango and has at least one down payment on any HardwarePaymentItem
OrderFlags.physicalIdPreidentified: If order is from Tango and order was sold in shop
OrderFlags.shopSales: If order is from Tango and order was sold in external store
OrderFlags.newDivaFlow: Go with the new DIVA flow.
OrderFlags.isSubOrder: If order is a sub order. Applies to return orders.

HardwareDelivery.dispatchDate: Date time with timezone according to ISO-8601. Timestamp of when the hardware has been sent out from warehouse.

Dealer.dealerName: name of the dealer like 'BtC Amager'.
Dealer.salesAgentCode: shall contain sales agent code (as handled by DealerAdmin), so far not used.
Dealer.posDealerId: id of the dealer in ODOO
Dealer.posSalesAgentId: id of the sales agent in ODOO

Person.birthday: Birthday in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).

Address.coName: Name of C/O (in care of) person.
Address.attention: Name of person (recipient). Mainly used for organization addresse where recipient is a specific person.

DanishAddress.streetNumberSuffix: Usually a letter right after the number (A in 10A, B in 15B)
DanishAddress.locality: for ex. V is the locality in COPENHAGEN V

InstallationAddress.addressRefId: This attribute is sent to LineInquiryAPI as DawaId. The field in LineInquiryAPI request for this is called addressId.

TelephoneNumber.countryCode: country code like '45' for Denmark or '372' for Estonia

OrderPart.references: Used to refer to existing entities like account or subscription. When ordering new additionalProduct on subscription, place subscription identifier here.
OrderPart.changeTypes: a Set of the types of changes contained in the orderpart
OrderPart.id: Identifies the element in collection uniquely in whole order. Is assigned by OrderAPI.
OrderPart.channelOrderPartId: Intended to identify the element uniquely in whole order. Can be assigned by external services.
OrderPart.splitOrderId: Intended to identify the element uniquely in whole order. Is assigned by OrderAPI.
OrderPart.taskUrl: Link to task for manual handling of the orderPart.
OrderPart.partTotal: Sum of all one time fees, charges, and additional product one time price (like hardware price).
OrderPart.hardwareTotalUpfront: Sum of hardware upfront amount (to be paid immediately).
OrderPart.productTotalUpfront: Sum of product upfront amount (to be paid immediately).
OrderPart.hardwareRecurringTotal: All hardware installment recurring payments per month.

PortingDetailsItem.networkOperatorId: Id of a network operator where the number is currently registered. Also known as number owner.
PortingDetailsItem.poaDocumentUrl: Location of document within Norlys domain.
PortingDetailsItem.digitalPoaAllowed: Indicates whether electronic Power of Attorney can be used.
PortingDetailsItem.powerOfAttorneyManualHandling: Indicates whether the POA shall be signed via manual flow.
PortingDetailsItem.earliestPortingDate: date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).
PortingDetailsItem.portAfterCommitment: true if customer wishes to be ported in after end of commitment at the current operator. Use instead of earliestPortingDate.
PortingDetailsItem.actualPortingDate: The date at which the porting is planned. Date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).

OrderItem.id: Identifies the element uniquely in whole order. Is assigned by OrderAPI.
OrderItem.channelOrderItemId: Intended to identify the element uniquely in whole order. Is assigned by the channel.

AccountItem.billingAccountNumber: BAN assigned to newly created account during processing.
AccountItem.delayOfPayment: Delay of payment in days. 0 - 999 values applicable.
AccountItem.ean: In case of OIO invoice type the EAN number must be given.
AccountItem.label: Serves for naming the account.
AccountItem.upTransferChargeCode: Code to define what is paid by the root ban and what is paid by the child ban.
AccountItem.productGroup: Currently home office or business internet, given in addInfo (cope order)

FeeItem.waived: Information if the item has been left

TerminationItem.effectiveDate: Effective date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).
TerminationItem.waiveTerminationFees: Flag indicating if fees connected to termination shall be waived.
TerminationItem.shouldTransferToDifferentPool: Flag indicating if the number should be transferred to a different pool after termination
TerminationItem.shouldReReserve: Flag indicating if the number should be re-reserved after termination

DiscountItem.discountCode: Discount code as registered in Fokus

RegretItem.effectiveDate: Effective date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).

SubscriptionItem.telephoneNumber: Has to be present when creating a new subscription. When asking for change on an existing subscription put local telephone number to OrderPart reference.
SubscriptionItem.productType: Type of the new offering (priceplan). Present only if newOfferingCode is present. (priceplans.xlsx.productType)
SubscriptionItem.offeringChangeType: Offering change type. Only for output.
SubscriptionItem.productCategory: Can contain TOUCHPOINT.MASTER, TOUCHPOINT.AA AND so on.
SubscriptionItem.isTransfer: The subscription is to be transfered to account that has different legal owner than the previous account.
SubscriptionItem.publishLevel: publish level (also known as directory listing)
SubscriptionItem.preferredActivationDate: Date YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601) of when the subscription shall be activated.
SubscriptionItem.realActivationDate: Date YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601) of when the subscription was really activated.
SubscriptionItem.productDeliveryAsap: Replaces the preferred activation date with installation and activation as soon as possible.
SubscriptionItem.label: Label for additional info about subscription
SubscriptionItem.effectiveMoveDate: Date YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601) of when the subscription was really activated.
SubscriptionItem.billingSystem: Specifies the billing system on subscription going to NOOS

Offering.name: Name of the whole offering that's to be displayed on web or documents.
Offering.productOfferingId: Id of the offering as provided by ProductCatalog.

SubscriptionUser.birthDate: BirthDate in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).

ForwardingSetting.targetNumber: Where to forward calls. Parameter is mandatory if enabled is set to true.

NoAnswerForwardingSetting.targetNumber: Where to forward calls. Parameter is mandatory if enabled is set to true.
NoAnswerForwardingSetting.delay: Delay after which to forward the call. Parameter is mandatory if enabled is set to true.

AdditionalProductItem.productCategory: The 'family' or group of additionalproducts. Can be null!
AdditionalProductItem.productCategories: List of categories from product catalog

HardwareSwapItem.oldSerialNumber: Serial number of old hardware to swap

ShippingDetails.userName: UserName label for the piece of hardware
ShippingDetails.userId: UserName label for the piece of hardware
ShippingDetails.department: UserName label for the piece of hardware
ShippingDetails.shippingConfirmedDate: date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).

ReturnDetails.creditInvoiceNumber: Credit invoice number for returned hardware of this order.
ReturnDetails.creditInvoiceDate: date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601) when was the credit invoice issued.

SimDetails.bindDeviceName: Name of the device to be binded.
SimDetails.waiveSimSwapFee: Indicates whether to apply the sim swap fee.

FixedNetDetails.internalCircuitId: Internal circuit id identifying the fixed line in Telia systems
FixedNetDetails.diggingDistance: Length of the distance from existing local line termination point to customer's premises.
FixedNetDetails.providerReuseOfAddress: Tells the provider that there is already a broadband connection, but it is not yours and you need to terminate it to create your own broadband connection.
FixedNetDetails.providerAoCustomerRefNumber: Reference number of customer within current provider.
FixedNetDetails.currentProviderName: Name of the current connectivity provider.

FixedNetFlags.providerChangeAccountNumberMissing: AO reference number is required to be captured in order for State Event
FixedNetFlags.customerRequestsChangeProvider: When customer wants Telia to do change provider on behalf of customer.(SBBU)

Amount.catalogAmount: original amount including VAT before applying any discount
Amount.catalogVat: original VAT amount before applying any discount

PilPayment.paymentId: Id of related payment entity in PaymentIntegrationLayer API
PilPayment.updatedAt: Date time with timezone according to ISO-8601
PilPayment.paymentRoundingError: Difference between hardware total upfront amount and payed total amount

Document.documentType: Type of document, enum comes from DocumentAPI (located in components.schemas.Document.properties.type)
Document.url: URL the document is located at

CreditWatchItem.amount: Credit watch amount limit in DKK.
CreditWatchItem.expirationDate: Credit watch expiration date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601)

SubscriptionOwnerControlItem.roamingCostControl: RCC - Controls limit settings for roaming
SubscriptionOwnerControlItem.unlimited: Indicates whether the costLimit is actually unlimited.

AccountOwnerControlItem.roamingCostControl: RCC - Controls limit settings for roaming
AccountOwnerControlItem.unlimited: Indicates whether the costLimit is actually unlimited.

CreditCard.expirationDate: Date in format YYYY-MM-DD (according to ISO 8601).
